rachel: quick dump from today's perf pass on host-side overheads. ran kernel-selection change + new batching heuristics against canary and saw a persistent ~9-12ms tail on short chat requests. not expected.

rachel: main suspects are: tokenization path + grpc small-write behavior + kv-cache thrash when requests interleave. attaching snippets below. @linh can you triage tokenization cost?

linh: looking. initial flame shows ~45% of CPU in `tokenize_chunk` for 1-3 token inputs. that seems high. did we regress the unicode fastpath?

samir: i can confirm small-write gRPC overhead is higher after the writev change. pprof shows syscalls spend ~6ms/warm call on avg. when batching turned up, kernel selection increased context switches.

alex: posting a trimmed log from canary (timestamps abridged):
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:31Z] request id=abc123 len=12 tokens total_time=28ms host_preproc=11ms tokenization=7ms grpc_write=6ms kvcache_lookup=2ms
[2026-03-19T14:02:31Z] request id=abc124 len=3 tokens total_time=22ms host_preproc=10ms tokenization=9ms grpc_write=5ms kvcache_lookup=1ms
```

alex: note the tokenization cost is dominating for tiny inputs. also kvcache_lookup spikes when there are many interleaved sessions (hot shard contention).

rachel: perfbot run attached: overall throughput didn't regress, but p99 latency moved from 42ms -> 53ms on small reqs.

perfbot: automated-profile: https://perf.internal/reports/2026-03-19/host-overhead-1759005555 (summary: tokenization hotpath, grpc small-writes, kv hot-shard). :white_check_mark:

linh: quick micro-ideas: 1) re-enable ascii-fastpath fallback for tokenization (cheap). 2) add pre-allocated token buffer per-thread to avoid tiny alloc churn. 3) measure aligning io to 8k chunks for gRPC writev.

samir: batching heuristic note: when kernel selects larger batch kernels for bursts, we see increased kvcache evictions because prefetch windows collide. heuristic should consider kvcache occupancy + session locality before switching kernel.

rachel: agree. add to action items: (A) linh tries ascii-fastpath + thread-local buffers (B) samir prototype kernel-selection rule: require kvcache-free > X or session locality score > Y before upshifting kernel (C) alex runs gRPC small-write experiment with coalescing writes into 8k windows for 24h canary.

alex: already started gRPC coalesce patch on a sidecar — will push canary tonight.

linh: quick patch plan for tokenization:
```diff
- decode_utf8_and_push()
+ if likely_ascii(input): fast_ascii_decode()
+ else decode_utf8_and_push()
```
linh: plus prealloc pool sized for 128 tokens/thread. should lower both CPU and alloc rate.

samir: for kernel selection, i'll add a lightweight kv_hit_rate metric to the decision. if kv_hit_rate < 0.8, never pick large-batch kernel. cheap check (histogram slot).

rachel: 👍 keep comments short in PRs and tag #eng-runtime. let's reconvene tomorrow after 12h canary runs. thanks everyone. :rocket:

alex: FYI, if gRPC coalesce helps we can flip small-write flag at edge proxy rather than runtime change. less invasive.

samir: noted. i'll add telemetry hooks so decision has a feedback loop (kv_hit_rate -> kernel choice).

rachel: created a tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RINF-1287 — put PR links and canary numbers there.

perfbot: follow-up scheduled: collect p50/p95/p99 and allocation profiles in 12h.

linh: starting tokenization patch now. will post microbench numbers in thread.

samir: working on kernel guardrail prototype. aim to have bench results by EOD.

alex: rolling gRPC coalesce canary at 19:30 PT. will report early stats.

rachel: great. thanks all.
